listed_quote.quote: FS Investment Corporation (NYSE: FSIC) and Corporate Capital Trust, Inc. (NYSE: CCT) have entered into a definitive agreement under which FSIC and CCT will be merged.

announcement.quote: FS/KKR Announces Agreement to Merge FS Investment Corporation and Corporate Capital Trust

outcome_evidence.quote: the merger of FS Investment Corporation (NYSE: FSIC) and Corporate Capital Trust, Inc. (NYSE: CCT) has closed

deals.notes: CCT merged with and into FSIC, FSIC surviving (CCT 10-Q excerpt, seq 9). Shareholders of both approved on 2018-12-03; closing announced 2018-12-19. FSIC renamed FS KKR Capital Corp. (ticker FSK).
